info.title: Latte API
info.description: Sales call compliance and coaching. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer latte_…`. Every response carries RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Reset headers. Create requests accept an `Idempotency-Key` header. Webhooks are signed with `Latte-Signature`; see the `webhooks` section.

post.summary: A call has its score and findings.
post.description: Answer 2xx within 10 seconds. Anything else is retried 8 times over about a day; after 50 failures in a row the endpoint is turned off.

parameters.name: Latte-Signature
parameters.description: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>"> under the endpoint's whsec_ secret

parameters.name: Latte-Delivery
parameters.description: The delivery id; the same on a redelivery, so use it to drop duplicates
